about.title: About TarraCoata Studio
about.paragraph1: TarraCoata Studio operates as a strategic digital partner, not just a development team. We focus on fewer clients with higher quality outcomes, prioritizing precision, measurable results, and long-term value over volume. Our approach is rooted in design systems, clean code architecture, and data-driven decision making that delivers exceptional digital experiences.
about.paragraph2: We work with businesses that understand the difference between a website and a strategic digital asset. Our clients value clarity, performance, and authority—and we deliver exactly that. Every project is an opportunity to build something exceptional, something that scales, and something that converts visitors into customers.

portfolio.title: Case Studies
portfolio.subtitle: Real problems solved with measurable results

1.title: Premium Retail Platform
1.description: Redesigned checkout flow reduced cart abandonment by 34% and increased conversion rate by 28% through strategic UX optimization.
1.challenge: High cart abandonment rate and low conversion on mobile devices were impacting revenue and customer satisfaction.
1.solution: Redesigned checkout flow with progressive disclosure, simplified forms, and mobile-first optimization. Implemented trust indicators, streamlined payment process, and enhanced user guidance throughout the journey.
1.outcome: Cart abandonment reduced by 34%, conversion rate increased by 28%, mobile revenue up 45%, and customer satisfaction scores improved significantly.

2.title: Analytics Dashboard
2.description: Complex data visualization made intuitive and actionable. User engagement increased 45% and support tickets decreased by 60%.
2.challenge: Complex data visualization was overwhelming users, leading to low engagement, high support ticket volume, and reduced product adoption.
2.solution: Redesigned dashboard with intuitive data hierarchy, customizable widgets, and interactive visualizations. Added comprehensive onboarding flow and contextual help to guide users effectively.
2.outcome: User engagement increased 45%, support tickets decreased by 60%, daily active users up 38%, and product satisfaction scores reached new highs.

3.title: Enterprise Website
3.description: Complete brand refresh and website rebuild. Page load speed improved 73%, organic traffic increased 52% in 6 months.
3.challenge: Outdated brand presence, slow load times, and poor SEO performance were hindering growth and brand perception in the market.
3.solution: Complete brand refresh with modern design system, comprehensive performance optimization, and strategic SEO implementation. Rebuilt with clean architecture and scalable infrastructure.
3.outcome: Page load speed improved 73%, organic traffic increased 52% in 6 months, brand recognition significantly enhanced, and lead generation up 40%.

4.title: High-Converting Landing Page
4.description: Conversion-focused design and strategic copy optimization. Lead generation increased by 89% while reducing cost per acquisition by 41%.
4.challenge: Low conversion rate on campaign landing pages and high cost per acquisition were limiting marketing ROI and growth potential.
4.solution: Conversion-focused design with clear value proposition, strategic social proof placement, and optimized form flow. Conducted A/B testing across multiple variations to maximize performance.
4.outcome: Lead generation increased by 89%, cost per acquisition reduced by 41%, ROI improved 3x, and campaign effectiveness reached new benchmarks.

5.title: Complete Brand Identity
5.description: Comprehensive visual identity system and cohesive digital presence. Brand recognition improved significantly across all touchpoints and channels.
5.challenge: Inconsistent brand presence across touchpoints and unclear brand positioning were diluting brand value and market recognition.
5.solution: Developed comprehensive brand identity system including logo, color palette, typography, and brand guidelines. Applied consistently across all digital touchpoints and marketing channels.
5.outcome: Brand recognition improved significantly, consistent messaging across all channels, stronger market positioning, and increased brand trust and loyalty.

6.title: Mobile-First Platform
6.description: Responsive design and comprehensive mobile optimization. Mobile conversion rate increased by 67% and user satisfaction scores improved dramatically.
6.challenge: Poor mobile experience was leading to low mobile conversion rates, high bounce rates, and lost revenue opportunities.
6.solution: Complete mobile optimization with responsive design, touch-friendly interactions, and mobile-specific features. Performance optimization for mobile networks and enhanced user experience throughout.
6.outcome: Mobile conversion rate increased by 67%, user satisfaction scores improved dramatically, mobile traffic engagement up 52%, and mobile revenue became a primary growth driver.

1.question: How long does a website project typically take?
1.answer: Timeline varies by project scope and complexity. A starter website typically takes 4-6 weeks, while a business website ranges from 8-12 weeks. Premium custom solutions are quoted individually based on specific requirements and scope. We provide detailed timelines and milestones during the discovery phase so you know exactly what to expect.

2.question: Do you offer ongoing support after launch?
2.answer: Absolutely. All projects include a support period (varies by package). We also offer comprehensive ongoing maintenance and support plans for long-term partnerships. This includes updates, security patches, content changes, performance monitoring, and strategic guidance as your business evolves.

3.question: Is the website SEO-ready at launch?
3.answer: Yes, every website includes comprehensive technical SEO setup: proper heading structure, optimized meta tags, alt text for images, XML sitemap, and performance optimization. We ensure your site is search-engine friendly from day one. Ongoing SEO strategy, content optimization, and performance tracking can be discussed as part of our support services.

4.question: Can I manage content myself after launch?
4.answer: Yes. Business and Premium packages include a content management system (CMS) that allows you to update content easily without technical knowledge. We provide comprehensive training and documentation so you can manage your site independently. We're always available for support when you need assistance or want to make more complex changes.

5.question: What makes TarraCoata Studio different?
5.answer: We focus on fewer clients with higher quality outcomes. Our approach combines strategic thinking, clean code architecture, and measurable results. We're not freelancers—we're strategic partners invested in your long-term success. Every decision is data-driven, aligned with your business objectives, and designed to deliver exceptional value.

6.question: Who is this studio NOT for?
6.answer: We're not the right fit if you're looking for the cheapest option, need something done in 48 hours, or want a template with minimal customization. We work with clients who value quality, understand the importance of strategy, and are committed to building something exceptional that drives real business results.

7.question: Can you scale with my business?
7.answer: Absolutely. We build with scalability in mind from day one. Whether you're starting small or need enterprise-level solutions, our architecture and approach support growth. We design systems that can evolve with your business needs, handle increased traffic, and adapt to new requirements over time.

8.question: How involved do I need to be during the process?
8.answer: We need your input during key phases: discovery (to understand your goals and vision), design reviews (to ensure alignment with your brand), and content provision. Beyond that, we handle the heavy lifting. Regular check-ins keep you informed without requiring constant involvement. We respect your time and ensure the process is efficient and transparent.
